name: Heckler soul
description: a damned soul of the Ember Wastes, stuck in Hell's loop forever: a thin hunched bald human figure in a long ragged ash-grey shroud, pale ash-grey skin, hollow tired eyes, a soft pale blue-white glow around its outline, bare feet, one thin arm raised with a pointing finger, lip curled, head thrown back sneering

poses.stand: standing hunched, one thin arm raised with a pointing finger
poses.react: sneering with a pointing finger raised, chin up

idle.action: rocks gently in place, breathing slowly

react.action: jeers, finger jabbing, shoulders shaking with a nasal laugh, then flatter
